carryHandResolution.visibleCarryHand: image-left / trailing hand, i.e. Piper’s rear hand in the right-facing profile; this same limb carries the invisible ball through pose00 approach, pose01 gather, pose02 plant, pose03 low rear start of sweep, and pose04 lowest rear sweep.
